skill.title: Hilltop
skill.promise: You can find where the slope goes flat.
skill.pipAbility: Pip can find a flat top.

lessons.title: Flat on top

screens.prompt: At the top, the next tiny step is...

feedback.wrong_option: Still climbing means you have not reached the top.

screens.correctMessage: The step at the top is flat.

screens.prompt: The step at the top does not rise or fall. Set the slope.

feedback.too_low: A flat step is not negative. The slope is zero.
feedback.too_high: A flat step is not positive. Move down.

screens.correctMessage: Slope zero, for this one step.

screens.prompt: Left of the top, the slope is positive. Right of the top, the slope is...

feedback.wrong_option: Past the top, the path falls. The slope changes sign.

screens.correctMessage: Right of the top, the slope is negative.

screens.prompt: At the top, walk a flat step. The ball should sit.

feedback.wrong_direction: The step at the top stays level.
feedback.wrong_length: The run continues and the rise is zero.

screens.correctMessage: The ball sits on the top.

screens.prompt: A training step at a flat top...

feedback.wrong_option: There is no climb left to follow. The step shrinks.

screens.correctMessage: A flat top quiets the step.

lessons.whyItMatters: A flat top is where a training step shrinks toward nothing.

lessons.title: Not the top

screens.prompt: A path climbs, goes flat for one step, then climbs again. That flat step is...

options.label: The top, because the slope is zero

feedback.wrong_option: The climb continues after the flat step. The top is still ahead.

screens.correctMessage: A shelf in a climb is not the top.

options.label: The slope changes from up to down
The slope is zero for any reason

feedback.wrong_option: Zero in the middle of a climb is a shelf, not a top.

screens.correctMessage: Up, then down, marks the top.

screens.prompt: Just left of the top: rise 6, run 2. Set the slope.
screens.correctMessage: Left of the top, the slope is positive.

screens.prompt: Just right of the top: fall 6, run 2. Set the slope.

feedback.too_low: A fall of 6 over 2 is lower. Move down.
feedback.too_high: That is past the fall. Move toward zero.

screens.correctMessage: Right of the top, the slope is negative.

screens.prompt: You found a flat step in the middle of a climb. You should...

options.label: Keep going, the top is still ahead
Stop, every flat step is the top

feedback.wrong_option: The next piece still climbs. This flat step is not the top.

screens.correctMessage: A shelf is not a reason to stop.

lessons.whyItMatters: A zero slope is the top only when the sides point opposite ways.
